correctness.rationale: The canonical 37-vertex quadratic-residue graph has exactly (37,333,888,555) simplices in dimensions 0-3 and none higher. Full signed boundary reconstruction confirms boundary-square zero on all 555 3-cells. The included 297-unit and 554-unit unimodular elimination certificates have zero and one-column residues respectively; the final residual gcd is 26. Hence exact integral H2 is Z^36 plus Z/26, with H1=H3=0. For all 666 affine automorphisms, signed simplicial Lefschetz values are (36,-1,0) in their respective classes and determine the rational augmentation representation.
